html:
I’m not big enough to feel that kind of pain. But it’s true that I’m less and less interested in doing science communication on Zhihu.

I put a lot of work into an article, and only two or three hundred people read it. Zhihu helped me rack up nearly 50,000 followers, so where are they?

One new gimmick after another keeps watering down the original aim of spreading knowledge, and the platform has turned into a total mishmash. Showbiz gossip and cheap wisecracks: it’s a bit like NetEase News used to be. But at least that one called itself “news.” You call yourself Zhihu, a name that literally asks “Do you know?”
